title: Currents
description: "Currents" is a contemporary dance piece that delves into the intricate relationship dynamics and collective human experience, inspired by the gravitational pulls and celestial forces that shape our lives. This performance explores the weight of existence, the rebound of emotions, and the surrender to life's currents, much like the wind carries us through calm and storm.
shortDescription: Co-created by Anne Neudorf and Rawda Mabrouk
